_comment: Ingest output for FIU-India AML/CFT Guidelines for VDA Service Providers (2023). This is the post-INGEST artifact: type + enforceable + text. match/expectScores/enforcementSignal are filled at the MAP step against a specific tenant. A broad AML program → most requirements are org/process (platform), with a config-checkable core. enforceable: config = checkable in Sumsub config; sdk/platform = NOT-CONFIG-REPRESENTABLE.
regulation: FIU-India AML/CFT Guidelines for VDA Service Providers (2023)

requirements.text: 5.7 No wallets under anonymous / pseudonymous / fictitious names; customer must be identified
requirements.note: level requires an identity step (no anonymous onboarding)

requirements.text: 5.7 Identify customer via PAN/National ID + an Officially Valid Document (passport, driving licence, Aadhaar, Voter ID, NPR letter)
requirements.note: level IDENTITY docSet accepts these doc types

requirements.text: 5.7b / 5.8.2 Identify and verify the beneficial owner (ultimate ownership/control)
requirements.note: KYB / COMPANY beneficiaries docSet for legal-person customers

requirements.text: 5.8.4 Adopt written CDD procedures per Rule 9 PMLR
5.9 / EDD Politically Exposed Persons identified and subject to EDD
5.9.2 Apply EDD to high-risk jurisdictions / persons / entities
5.9 If EDD cannot be completed, terminate the relationship and file an STR
requirements.note: termination routable in workflow; the STR filing itself is platform

requirements.text: 5.9.1 Reasonable measures to establish the customer's source of funds (risk-based)
5.10 Sanctions screening on every VDA transfer; hold wallet until screening clears
5.11 Counterparty due diligence on VDA transfers (counterparty wallet type, risk)
5.8 Ongoing, risk-sensitive CDD; more frequent review of higher-risk customers/transactions
requirements.note: ongoing transaction monitoring cadence — platform/KYT runtime, not static config

requirements.text: 5.8 Retain KYC/identification records (encrypted) for at least five years
requirements.note: data retention — platform, not Sumsub config

requirements.text: 5.4.2.1 File Suspicious Transaction Reports to FIU-IND within 7 working days
5.4 Appoint a Designated Director and a Principal Officer; notify FIU-IND within 7 days
requirements.note: org governance — out of scope for config

requirements.text: 5.2/5.3 Board- and senior-management-approved AML/CFT/CPF program & internal controls
5.5 Role-based AML/CFT training; employee screening on hiring
5.6 Independent internal audit/inspection of AML controls
5.1 Register as a Reporting Entity with FIU-IND
